# The problem

Opens where almost everybody is standing — agents already running, and no way to say what wrong means — and lands on the delta. Stops there.

Read live out of vault `posrhzp3` with its published read key. [How this works →](../../../../docs/vault/reading-a-vault-file.md)

## What this deck is doing

| **The problem it starts from** | I do not know what my agents are doing |
|---|---|
| **What it answers** | Observation: records of what they did, passive mode, a status block |
| **Vocabulary it introduces** | the record · grant · mandate · delta |
| **Who it is for** | a first conversation: the person who owns the risk, or the person who owns the agents |
| **Roughly** | 12 minutes |
| **Where it deliberately stops** | bands, limits, refusals, pools, premiums, price — none of it appears |

It ends on the question it does not answer — **“The delta is enormous. What do I do about it?”** — which is where [The map](map.md) picks up.

## Notes on this deck

Nothing has been written here yet. This section is the reason each deck has a page of its own: room for what the slides cannot carry — where the argument came from, what changed since, what an audience pushed back on, and any recording that narrates it.
